'''Grand Chieftain''' was the title that the [[Flesh Raider]] [[Keshk]] held as leader of his species on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. During the [[Flesh Raider uprising]] in [[3643 BBY]], Keshk commanded the [[Flesh Raider army]] and performed the bidding of his master, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Bengel Morr]]. After Keshk's death and Morr's defeat, the army dissolved, and it is unknown whether any attempted to take his place as Grand Chieftain.
